title: Clean Blender II Brush
descriptionHtml:
✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: A soft, densely packed cream brush for seamless blending and the ideal companion for cream bronzer, blush, and contour.

Brush Formulation: All Formulas

Brush Coverage: Buildable

Bristle Type: Synthetic

Ingredient Callouts: It is cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: Handmade in Kumano, Japan by master artisans, this expertly crafted brush delivers optimal product pickup and seamless application for cream formulas. Sustainably sourced and cruelty-free, the soft, dense bristles blend effortlessly for a natural finish. Perfect for layering and blending Sun Tone Bronzing Crème's dual tones.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Use with Sun Tone Bronzing Crème (sold separately) or any cream bronzer, blush, or contour.
-Blend formula seamlessly in upward and outward motions for a natural finish.
-Clean regularly with gentle brush cleanser to maintain bristle quality.
